children.value: > Fact From Story: The NMPA believes generative AI is the greatest risk to the human creative class that has ever existed.
> > Fact From Story: The NMPA submission advocates for regulations to ensure the interests of musical artists and music rights holders are not subjugated in the AI frenzy.
> > > > Fact From Story: The NMPA's submission stresses that its members are not opposed to AI.
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: Claiming not to be opposed to something can still be compatible with believing it carries risk.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Advocating for regulations implies a belief that without them, there is a risk to the regulated group.
> Fact From Story: The NMPA's submission stresses that its members are not opposed to AI.
> > Fact From Story: However, the development of the generative AI marketplace is marked by breathtaking speed, size and complexity. | Fact From Story

> > > > Fact From Story: The NMPA is advocating for regulations and principles that it sees as the right approach to ensuring that the interests of musical artists and music rights holders don’t end up subjugated in the frenzy to build our brave new AI-powered world. | Fact From Story
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: Regulation is often needed when a market is developing rapidly. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Rapid development of a market can lead to unforeseen risks. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge: A group can be not opposed to something while still believing it poses a significant risk.
